newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Eqdom to issue $37.3 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Eqdom to issue $37.3 mln notes.

text.p: Morocco's largest credit firm Eqdom said on Friday it will issue 350 million dirhams ($37.3 million) three-year fixed rate notes next month.
Subscription, will be opened to the public, including foreign institutions, from 2 to 30 June, the firm said.
The issue is divided in 1,400 notes of 250,000 dirhams ($26,881) at an annual fixed rate of 9.5 percent, a spokesman said.
The notes will be negotiable on the Casablanca stock exchange, he said. Maturity date was set for July 1, 2000, he said.
Morocco's Attijari Finances and Banque Commerciale du Maroc firms were chosen for the notes' issue, he added.
Established in Casablanca in 1974 by Morocco's Caisse Centrale de Guarantie and Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Eqdom holds 35 percent of Morocco's market's credit share, Upline Securities said.
It showed provisional net profit 96 million dirhams ($10.32 million) last year from 114.4 million dirhams in 1995.
Listed on the bourse in 1978, Eqdom has a capital of 167 million of dirhams.
Among the 47 listed firms, Eqdom was last traded at 952 dirhams, brokers said.
